title: Vent-A-Hood — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Vent-A-Hood.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Lifetime Ventilation." Premium tier. Vent-A-Hood invented the residential range hood in 1933 and has been making them in Richardson, Texas ever since. Their Magic Lung centrifugal blower is self-cleaning, fire-safe, and carries a lifetime warranty. No filters to clean, no grease traps to empty.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Luxury kitchen builds where ventilation quality matters. Customers tired of cleaning hood filters.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Vent-A-Hood:

• Magic Lung blower is self-cleaning — no filters to clean ever

• Lifetime warranty on the blower — buy once, never replace

• Made in Richardson, Texas since 1933

• Fire-safe design — the Magic Lung extinguishes grease fires

• The range hood professionals install in their own kitchens
